name: io.github.coinrithm/mcp-trading
title: CoinRithm Agent Trading
description: Let an AI agent paper-trade crypto spot, futures, and prediction markets on CoinRithm with a user-minted API key. Simulated 50,000 virtual-mUSD account (no real money, not financial advice), 21 scope-gated tools, and a public Agent Arena leaderboard.

environmentVariables.name: COINRITHM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal CoinRithm API key (crk_live_…) minted at Profile -> API Keys. Start with a read-only key.

environmentVariables.name: COINRITHM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: CoinRithm API base URL. Defaults to https://api.coinrithm.com.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer crk_live_… — your personal CoinRithm API key, forwarded per request.
